tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gnam gyi bu jing gir gyi rgyal rgyud a bu btsun pas bzhengs pa sher phyin la

sogs pa'i dkar chag bzhugs so// na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs gser gyi sa 'dzin rnam bkra mtshan dpe'i bang rim can// bden don gzhom med rdo rje'i drug skyes 'gro la gshin pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog /rab yangs shes bya ji lta ji snyed mkhyen gzigs rnyog pa spangs pa rab zhi'i thugs// mi 'phrog dpa' bo ngag gi dbang po bdag snying pad+mor rab tu bsten// de yang snyigs ma lnga bdo yi// dus kyang rdzogs ldan la 'gong pa'i// rnam dkar rgya chen 'di ko zhes// snyan pa'i gtam gyi dga' ston spel// de yang lho 'dzam bu gling las kyi sa pa dag gi tshal la shar phyogs jing gir hor gyi yul zhes bya ba dag bde bar skyong bar byed pa'i rgyal rigs/ shing sā la lta bur brjid chags pa gur dkar dang*/ gur ser| gur nag ces grags pa las/ hor gur ser gyi brgyud pa/ gnam gyi bu jing gir rgyal po og len dang*/ yu gur la sogs pa rgyal rabs mang dag zhig 'das pa'i rigs su/ 'khor tsha chen po kun las rgyal zhes pa sa gsum du dpa' ba dang*/ rnam par gnon pa la sogs pa ni ā di te'i bu yang skyengs par byed pa/ nor rdzas kyi longs spyod ni gnod sbyin gyi bdag po chen po rnams kyi dpal 'phrog pa la gdon mi za ba de nyid kyi rigs las/ byang rgyud kyi rgyal po 'khor tsha g.yul rgyal zhes bya ba'i khab tu/ 'gru rgyal skyu ra'i rigs kyi dbon mo lcam mgo mgo zhes bya ba byon pa la sras gnyis bltams nas/ rgyal po de nyid gnam du gshegs pa'i rgyal sa rgyal po de'i gcen po karma skyong zhes bya bas bskyangs pa'i sras su rgyal po btsun pa zhes bya ba 'di nyid bltams pa las/ na tshod longs pa'i tshe dkar phyogs kyi lha srung chen po rnams kyis yang dag par thugs brgyud bskul te/ 'khor ba'i gnas dang zang zing gi longs spyod ni sgyu mas sprul ba'i cho 'phrul dang*/

chu bur dang gzha' tshon la sogs pa ji lta bar med bzhin du/ snang ba'i snying pos dben pa'i mi rtag cing 'jig pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang mi shes pa byis pa'i blo can rnams ni gnas de lta bu la dga' ba dang*/ skyid pa dang bde ba dam par bzung bas zo chun ltar 'khor ba nyid du 'khor gyi/ yang la la dag gis ni gnas de dag spong ngo zhes phyogs med du rlung ltar rgyu bar byed kyang*/ bza' ba dang gyon pa'i cha tsam la chags pas 'ching ba mi shes par slar 'khor bar rdeg 'chos pa 'di ko las/ shes ldan 'dis ni de dag spangs pa tsam las rnam par dkar ba'i phyogs su longs spyad na 'bras bu mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ rang gzhan thams cad la phan par 'gyur ba'i lhag pa'i bsam sbyor ches dkar ba stobs che ba yongs su 'du bgyis te/ rgyal po sngon du gshegs pa dag gi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ rang gi longs spyod don ldan dang*/ dal 'byor 'bras yod du bya ba'i phyir thog mar byang phyogs su gangs ljongs zhes bya bar bdag cag gi ston pas rab tu byung ba rnams kyis yon yongs su sbyong ba dang bstan pa spel ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi sbyin gnas dam par ji srid mgon po ma pham pa zhing 'dir mngon par rdzogs pa sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bka' bsgos pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug gi gtso bo bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can dang*| dge bsnyen dharma tā dang*/ sbyin bdag gong ma ta'i mi hwa shang*/ srung ma rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa'i sku thang grwa tshar legs par bzhengs nas bzo bo rnams yon gyis yongs su mnyes par mdzad/ slar yang dbur stod rgya ma khri khang zhes ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas skal ldan shing rta sangs rgyas dbon ston zhes pa'i tshul bzung bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der/ tsan+dan dmar po bzang po las grub pa'i rnam par snang mdzad/

'jam pa'i dbyangs/ rgyal ba byams pa/ mgon po mi 'khrugs pa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas rnams kyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i nang du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung*/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi ring bsrel/ rdo rje 'chang nas bdag nyid kyi bar gyi brgyud pa dam pa rnams kyi sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang 'phel gdung la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i phyag phreng*/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi gdung rus/ jo bo rje'i na bza'/ 'brom ston pa'i gdung rus/ bshes gnyen po to ba'i thugs/ stag lung thang pa'i dbu zhwa/ karma pa rang byung rdo rje'i zhwa nag /karma pa na rim dang*/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa na rim gyi gdung dang na bza' la sogs te/ mdor na rgyal dbang rat+na'i mtshan/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rje btsun bkra shis phun tshogs/ bdag cag dang bcas pa rnams kyis bka' dgongs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams su legs par bsgrubs pa'i chos sman rnams bzhugs pas chos sman de rnams kyi phab rgyun du ngo mtshar zhing ya mtshan che ba'i rten gang bzhugs pa de dag 'di rnams su bzhugs pa gdon mi za'o// yang rje sgam po pa nor bu rgyan pa'i sku brnyan tsan+dan dmar po las grub pa de'i nang du ni sgam po rang du ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rten rnams bzhugs pa dang*| tsan+dan sa mchog gi rigs dkar po la kho bo'i 'dra 'bag byas pa 'di'i nang du sngar smos pa'i rten rnams dang*/ bdag rang gi mgo skyes dang yan lag gi sen mo dang lwa ba la sogs pa rnams kyang bcug yod/ gzhan yang mdo phran dang*/ gzungs kyi rigs nyer mkho dang lhan cig tu bsdoms pa bka' bsdus su btags pa/ shog bu dung gi kha dog lta bu la bris pa glegs bam shin tu che ba dang bcas pa bzhengs so// ji zhig na stobs kyi dbang phyug 'di ni/ dper na lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho chen po ni chu phran stong khri bab kyang ngoms par mi nus shing mi'i ro la sogs pa mi gtsang ba dang zhag gcig kyang mi 'grogs la/

mtsho phran rnams ni 'bab chu'i rgyun re re bab pas kyang gang zhig ngoms la ro la sogs pa mi gtsang ba dang 'grogs bzhin par gnas pa ltar skye rgu dman pa rnams ni dge ba'i phyogs phran bu tsam byas par yang tshims shing ngoms pas kun la longs spyod cing*/ mi dge ba'i las gang la yang bag med par spyod pa la ngoms pa med mod/ rgyal po chen po blo dang ldan pa 'dis ni mi dge ba'i las chung ngu tsam la yang dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas ltar ya nga zhing bag tsha bar blta la/ rnam par dkar ba'i las la ni ngoms shing chog mi shes pas sngar smos pa'i dge ba'i phyogs de rnams kyis kyang ma tshim par/ slar yang bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i bka' 'khor lo bar pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa 'bum legs par bzhengs par bzhed cing*/ byis pa'i skye bo rnams ni rgyu mtshan dang dgos pas dben ba'i las 'ba' zhig la brtson la/ blo dang ldan pa rnams ni rgyu mtshan gal po che mthong ba dag gis las gang yin pa der 'jug pa chos nyid yin pas des na 'dir yang*/ ji skad du/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i glegs bam chen po yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ na bza' dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dang*/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur stir bya/ bla mar bya/ ri mor bya/ mchod par bya/ brjod par bya/ gsol bar bya ste/ kun dga' bo/ 'di ni nga'i gdams ngag go// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ kun dga' bo/ da lta nga bzhugs te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i sku 'di la khyod kyis dga' ba dang*/ dad pa dang*/ ri mor byas pa de bzhin du/ nga 'das nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la yang rim gror byos shig /kun dga' bo/ ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa 'di nub par mi 'gyur zhing ci nas kyang khyod skyes bu tha mar mi 'gyur bar khyod la lan gnyis lan gsum du yongs su gtad do// rjes su gtad do// kun dga' bo/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'jig rten na ji srid du spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs par rigs par bya'o| |kun dga' bo/ de srid du de bzhin gshegs pas chos ston par rigs par bya'o// kun dga' bo/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyan pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*| klog pa dang*/ kun chub par byed pa dang*/ rab tu 'don pa dang*/ lung nod pa dang*/ ston pa dang*/ kha ton du byed pa dang*/ 'bri ba dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ na bza' dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dag dang*/ kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i phreng ba dag dang*/ mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis bkur stir byed/ bla mar byed/ mchod par byed/ brjod par byed/ gsol bar byed pa'i sems can de dag ni sangs rgyas mthong ba dang ma bral ba dang*/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang ma bral ba dang*/ dge 'dun la rim gro byed pa dang ma bral bar rigs par bya'o// kun dga' bo/ sems can de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i drung na spyod par rigs par bya'o// zhes dang*/ 'phags pa sdud pa las/ gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur ba// bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te// 'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na// mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod// ces sogs phan yon brjod kyis mi lang ba gsungs pa de lta bu la dgongs te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rgyas pa 'bum phreng ba can rin po che gser dang dngul spel bas legs par bzhengs pa ni/ e phyogs rig pa'i 'byung khungs nas dpon yig tog dkar la mkhas pa dpon bsam 'phel gyis gtsos pa'i 'bri mkhan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung gi stod kyi cha/ zur re chos khri thang du chu stod zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi yan lag lnga rab tu dge ba'i dus dbu btsugs nas/

slar mgo 'jo'i thang zhes par sbra nag gzhi phab ste yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ mdo bskal pa bzang po dang*/ brgyad stong pa sogs bar chad med par legs par grub pa'i do dam ni 'bras yul skyed mos tshal 'og gi chos grwa chen po'i rab 'byams smra ba grags pa legs bshad kyis bgyis shing*/ zhu dag byed po gad la 'or ba'i chos mdzad rin chen phan bde dang*/ nyi khri btsang skad pa gnyis kyis phyi mo dang bstun te dag par byas la/ spang sna rin chen nas lha bris kyi rig byed sprul sku spo bo lu gu zhes pas/ o rgyan rin po che pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i sku paṇ+ḍi ta'i cha lugs dang*/ mnyam med dkon mchog rin chen gyi sku thang*/ bdag gi 'dra 'bag dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed phyag gnyis pa/ loka tri pā la zhi drag /ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ bstan srung a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i sku brnyan rnams dang*/ dpon mo ga gzi'i 'dod lha bdag gi gzugs brnyan dang*/ yang rgya ma bye chen sprul sku bas rje sgam po pa nor bu rgyan pa sgam po sprul pa'i sku/ rje stag lung pa ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub/ kong po grub chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnams dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku brnyan brgya phrag bcu la sogs pa rnams kyang gnas mal de nyid du grub par bzhengs te/ rab tu gnas pa ni gnas mal de nyid du sa khams nor skyong gi lo/ ston zla ra ba khrum stod bu mo'i khyim gyi dmar po'i dga' ba dang por/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa lha lnga dpal rga lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi thugs dam dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga ltar 'dus pa rgya mtsho dang lhan cig par/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i khur rnams rang nyid kyis bgyis te sta gon dang*/ de'i phyi nyin bzang po dang po dkar po nam gru'i 'grub sbyor shin tu dge ba'i nyin rab tu gnas pa dngos gzhi legs par bsgrubs shing*/

slob dpon mchod pa dang dga' ston la sogs pa gya nom pas rdzogs ldan gyi dpal yon la 'gran par nus pa dge legs kyi dpal 'du bar bgyis te/ bkra shis dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam pa du mas brjid chags shing*/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba rnams gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi go 'phang dam pa gnyis la gegs med par sbyor ba'i bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam rnam par dag pas rgyas btab ste dge ba'i rtsa ba nam mkha'i khong du yang shong bar mi nus pa dag gor ma chag par grub par bgyis so// e ma/ tshogs gnyis grub pa'i shing rta che// gang yang gzhom pa'i phul chen pos// legs par drangs pa'i sa skyong 'di// rnam pa kun tu dge bar gyur// ces pa'ang byang khams rgyal bu a bu btsun pas sku gsung thugs kyi rten ya mtshan pa bzhengs pa'i dkar chag tu/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas sa khyi zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer bdun la pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa dag go/ //maṅga laṃ//
